description: EMOM schedule and end logging without a completion counter (REQ-011; C31, C32; R40, R43, R44, R84) delivered through the EMOM owner EmomBlock (src/ui/emom-block.tsx: the annotated NOT STARTED and WORK phase captions removed while the minute, each movement's minute assignment and target, Now/Next, REST, PAUSED, FINISHED EARLY and COMPLETE stay; the natural-end sentence replaced by the end log) and the accepted shared owner TimedResultLog (src/ui/refinements/timed-result-log.tsx: its EMOM family, with no minutes-completed counter, no completion question and no confirmation step, and one group holding the existing optional notes), on the real /workout route (JOURNEY-011) through Start, a minute boundary and its rest, Pause/Resume, the natural end, Finish early, the section save, a reload, a failed save and its retry, and the History read. The schedule as specified is assumed: the saved block_results row carries the athlete's exception note in the block's existing notes column through the shell's one writer and no minutes_completed, elapsed time or completion flag; an early finish keeps its actual stop and is never recorded as a completed schedule; older stored records and saved rows read exactly as before. The accepted gallery states /gallery/refinements?state=emom and the cards state's Workout EMOM (reference eded158cfd928d382c9a9409e2c372270312741d) draw the actual EmomBlock. Every declared case must execute and pass; TASK-006's EMOM-named case in the same file is selected by the pattern and must pass too, but is not declared here.
